subject.title: feat: validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox adopt `--require-artifact-schema` and its dependency-free JSON Schema subset as a supported public CLI contract?
rationale: The PR adds a new repeatable flag, new exit behavior, a schema language that must remain compatible over time, and an explicit SSH-only provider boundary; code review cannot determine whether those permanent product commitments are desired.

options.title: Adopt the narrow contract
options.body: Fix strict parsing, require live SSH-backed proof, and merge the documented fail-closed subset as the supported first version.

options.title: Keep validation repository-owned
options.body: Decline the new core flag and continue requiring repository commands to validate evidence before `--require-artifact` checks existence.

options.title: Redesign the interface
options.body: Pause this PR and define a broader artifact-validation capability or delegated-provider contract before adding a public flag.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Fix strict parsing, require live SSH-backed proof, and merge the documented fail-closed subset as the supported first version.

likelyOwner.reason: As the identified project creator, `steipete` is the best available routing candidate for accepting or rejecting a permanent CLI contract.
